title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for r_0 with appropriate units.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly calculates the total energy of the positron and accounts for the mass difference.

title: Coulomb Energy Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student uses the correct formula for the Coulomb energy of uniformly charged spheres.

title: Mass Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies and calculates the mass difference between the two nuclei involved in the decay.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the correct sign in energy calculations, leading to incorrect results.

title: Neglecting Recoil
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly includes the recoil energy of the nucleus in their calculations.

title: Radius Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the formula for the radius of the nucleus based on the mass number.
